# Cedar Grove School

> Cedar Grove School is a small, Waldorf-inspired, nature-based, not-for-profit elementary school (Junior Kindergarten to Grade 5) on an organic farm in Prince Edward County, Ontario, Canada. Children learn outdoors, work with their hands, and let childhood unfold at its natural pace. Tagline: "Where childhood grows naturally."

## Key facts

- Location: 2590 County Rd 15, Picton, Ontario K0K 2T0 (Prince Edward County)
- Grades: Junior Kindergarten to Grade 5, growing to Grade 8 over time
- Programs: Early Years (JK to Grade 1), Lower Grades (Grades 2 to 5), and a part-time program (Grade 2 to 5 students join on Fridays)
- Class size: student-to-teacher ratio of 8:1
- Day: arrival 8:40, departure 3:30, with a minimum of two hours outdoors each day
- Tuition 2026-2027: $3,000 to $12,500 per year depending on days per week (one to five); lump sum or ten monthly payments; 5% sibling discount
- Status: registered not-for-profit
- Contact: Admin@cedargroveschool.ca
- Apply: https://form.jotform.com/251934741370053
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cedargroveschool.pec/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/cedargroveschoolpec/
